notes: No sommaire survives (the programme table at the end of the book is not in the OCR). Lessons rebuilt from the title line repeated at the top of each lesson page (opener OCR) + headings, in page order; flat list (book has no printed units). Excluded: أتدرب على حل المسائل / أحرر وضعية (problem-solving practice), أوظف مكتسباتي وأقيمها (evaluation, e.g. p.37-39, 105-107, 140-141), أتسلى / من عجائب الأعداد / لعبة الأرقام (games), and the unlabelled problem pages 52-55. 5 positional placeholders where no page carried a readable title (content hints: p.80-83 capacity units, p.113-117 multiplication by 3-digit numbers, p.118-120 area, p.130-133 multiples, p.148-153 area of rectangle/square). The second money lesson's denomination parenthesis was unreadable, so it is identified by pages. Pages 134-136 assumed to belong to القسمة الإقليدية or the multiples lesson (uncertain).
